lines: Apni marzi se kahan apne safar ke hum hain
couplets.en: How much of this journey is ours to choose?

lines: Rukh hawaon ka jidhar ka hai, udhar ke hum hain
couplets.en: Wherever the wind turns, there we go.

lines: Pehle har cheez thi apni, magar ab lagta hai
couplets.en: Everything once felt like ours, but now it seems otherwise.

lines: Apne hi ghar mein kisi doosre ghar ke hum hain
couplets.en: Even in our own home, we feel we belong somewhere else.

lines: Waqt ke saath hai mitti ka safar sadiyon se
couplets.en: Dust has traveled with time for centuries.

lines: Kisko maloom kahan ke hain, kidhar ke hum hain
couplets.en: Who knows where we come from, or where we belong?

lines: Chalte rehte hain ki chalna hai musafir ka naseeb
